description: Collaborative, open multilingual dataset of sentences and translations exposed through a public read-only API; by default, sentence search may include unapproved or orphaned (likely unproofread) sentences unless filtered.
resolution_notes: base_url: incorrect; the production server is https://api.tatoeba.org (https://api.tatoeba.org/openapi.json). example: incorrect; the 2026 migration guide maps v0 search to /v1/sentences, from to lang, query to q, and Japanese translations to trans:lang=jpn (https://en.wiki.tatoeba.org/articles/show/api-migration-v1); response shape follows https://api.tatoeba.org/openapi.json. description: incorrect; the API is public, unauthenticated and read-only, and its search docs warn that results include unapproved or orphaned sentences by default (https://api.tatoeba.org/openapi.json).
